native_mechanisms: Lay both cords' symbol-shaped coils in a row and walk them side by side, counting one 'fire' per exactly matching coil pair (diagonal match counting, no gaps).

Allow the boundary door between the rows to break exactly once per crossing: one shadow-row coil crouches past the quarrel, shifting the rest out of step by one — try this break at every quarrel position, never twice in a crossing.
Store each finished crossing's fire-pile in its own room, sink the failed/twice-broken crossings into the underground tower unread, and bring back only the highest pile as the final count.
core_technique: Exact banded anti-diagonal (wavefront) Needleman-Wunsch with AVX2 SIMD, where the band half-width is derived from a score lower bound obtained by scanning the ungapped and all single-shift alignments; plain two-row DP fallback for small n.
